notes: Normal UI expedition and walk from Many Hearths to shell bed, gather one, walk back to cook/eat, then walk to build first midden.
Midden stage growth uses 40 fixture shells; gamepad input is simulated, no physical controller.
Obsidian x2, stone x1, wood x1 gathered through normal E actions; travel positions between outcrop/resources/workshop are explicit fixtures.
Opening inventory cancels knapping with all materials retained. Second knap completes and hafting consumes the blade and wood, leaving hammerstone.
Two Chrome renderers plus three WebSocket peers; portrait/landscape browser viewports; physical mobile untested.
